label: Inversion / LRR / IV candidate

harvest.describes: FST / dxy / piN / piS windows overlapping the candidate interval
per-trio Mendelian error rate on the candidate's chromosome (inside-vs-flank requires the windowed variant; v0 attaches the whole-chromosome table)
pairwise relatedness on the candidate's chromosome
promoted candidate metadata carrying the candidate_id directly
chain-readiness evidence rows keyed by candidate_id

describes: The inversion/LRR candidate as a first-class derived object. Rows live in the inversion_candidates layer (02_sets/candidates/inversion_candidates.tsv); this registry row declares the object kind + how to harvest evidence from across atlases. Three join modes: spatial_window (result rows carry chrom+start+end, kept where they overlap the candidate interval), chromosome (per-chromosome result file attached whole), direct_fk (result rows carry candidate_id). Per ADDON_SPEC §1 row G (derived object) + the candidate_harvester.
